def solve(inp):
    H=len(inp); W=len(inp[0])
    # background = most common color
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for row in inp for v in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[row[:] for row in inp]
    spec=[v for v in cnt if v!=bg]
    sp=spec[0]
    def run(r,c,d):
        return any(inp[r+k][c]==sp for k in range(1,H) if all(0<=r+k<H and 0<=c<W and inp[r+k][c]==bg for k in [1])) # placeholder
    res=set()
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if inp[r][c]!=bg and inp[r][c]!=sp: continue
            L=all(0<=c-k and inp[r][k]==bg for k in range(c))
            R=all(c+k<W and inp[r][k]==bg for k in range(1,c+1))
            U=all(0<=r-k and inp[k][c]==bg for k in range(r))
            D=all(r+k<H and inp[k][c]==bg for k in range(1,r))
            if (L and R and (U or D)) or (U and D and (L or R)):
                res.add((r,c))
    for (r,c) in res: out[r][c]=sp
    return out

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
from collections import Counter, deque
def show(name):
    inp=G[name+' input']; out=G[name+' output']
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])

for name in ('Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3'):
